title: Questions 161-163 refer to the following announcement.
passage_1:
To:All Staff <team@marlowepartners.com>
From:Gregor Vance <vance@marlowepartners.com>
Date:April 2
Subject:Notice

Dear Staff,

As mentioned at last month’s staff department meeting, the atrium renovation project will start as planned on April 9 and finish on May 6. Throughout this period, staff and guests will have to enter the office through the loading entrance. – [1] –.

During the week of April 16 to 23, only the freight lift at the north end of the building will be running. – [2] –. Because lift capacity will be reduced in that week, we ask that only those carrying heavy equipment use the lift. – [3] –. If you are able to use the stairwell, please do so.

Normal lift service will return on April 24, though the finishing work in the atrium will continue until May 6. Please advise all clients, contractors, and guests that the atrium is under renovation and will be fenced off. – [4] –. A security guard will be stationed nearby to enforce the restriction for the duration of the work.

Thank you for your patience while we improve our atrium.

Sincerely,
Gregor Vance
Operations Director
Marlowe Partners
